note: How a client assembles, scores and judges a course's unit tests and section exams, and how placement chains the exams (#224). Decoded by the web: apps/web/src/lib/features/courses/tests.test.ts. The seeded picks themselves (the placement generator and the token shuffle) are not pinned here; the counts, pools and rules are.

budget.doc: questions Q split into grammar min(G, ceil(Q/5)), text min(T, ceil(Q/5)), words the rest (at most two questions per askable word); what the words cannot use goes to grammar, then text, up to what they have.

cases.name: few words: the rest goes to grammar
words only, two questions per word
a big section with one text gap
a short test keeps one of each

sample.doc: The word sample is the level check's planner (lib/placement/levelCheck.ts planCheck): each stratum (a unit test: the unit's word lessons; an exam: the section's units) gets an even share of the words the app does not call known; known ones fill only what is left. perStratum counts the sampled words of each stratum; includes lists entries that must be in the sample.

cases.name: known words are left out while others remain
known words fill what the others cannot
an even share over the strata
the sample never exceeds the words

tones.doc: A Chinese reading question: the variants of a pinyin reading are the same syllables with one syllable's tone changed to another of tones 1-4, syllable by syllable, tone by tone; three of them are the wrong choices. The answer is the syllables joined by one space.

sentences.doc: A reading text is cut into sentences after 。！？!? (and runs of them) and at line breaks; each sentence trimmed, empty ones dropped.

gap.doc: A text question: the first literal occurrence of the word's form in the sentence is the gap (blankSpans without segmenter matches); at least two letters must stay outside it; three wrong choices from the candidates (pickDistractors: none that occurs in the sentence, never the answer), else no question.

cases.name: the sentence is only the word
the word is not in the sentence

judge.doc: passed = total is 0, or score * 100 >= passPercent * total (score: right first answers).

decide.doc: A placement exam stops once decided: pass when score * 100 >= passPercent * total already; fail when even every question left right would not reach it; else open (null). The event then records score of asked.

placement.doc: Placement chains the section exams from the first section with one. After a pass: the next section with an exam (null: the chain ends) and the section 'Start here' places into (the next section). After a fail: the section the learner is placed into: the failed one, or the course's first section when the first exam failed.
